Subject: Rider Alert GGTransit King Tides & Ongoing Flooding
TextBody:
*Be prepared! Some bus stops are likely to flood and may be closed during high tide events. *

For a list of predicted King Tides in the North Bay, visit Coastalca.com. [ https://www.coastal.ca.gov/kingtides/ ]

*These Stops May Flood*

 

*Alternate Bus Stop*

 

*Route(s) affected *

 

Miller Ave & Camino Alto

 

Miller Ave & Reed St

 

Route 114

 

Almonte Blvd & Miller Ave

 

Miller Ave & Reed St

 

Route 114

 

Almonte Blvd & Rosemont Ave

 

Miller Ave & Reed St

 

Route 114

Shoreline Hwy, at the Buckeye

 

Route 114

 

Manzanita Park & Ride

 

Shoreline Hwy, at the Buckeye

 

Route 114, Route 120

 

Shoreline Hwy & Pohono St

Lucky Dr Bus Pad Southbound

Seminary Dr Bus Pad Southbound

 

Tiburon Wye Bus Pad

 

Route 120, Route 132

For trip-planning assistance, call 511/415-455-2000/TDD 711. Customer service representatives are available weekdays from 7:00 am to 6:00 pm.
